summary.text: Debra Moody is a Republican state representative from Covington representing Tennessee House District 81 (Tipton and part of Haywood Counties), a member of the 108th through 114th General Assemblies. She chairs the House Calendar & Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Moody is married and has four children.
Her House page lists her occupation as wife, mother and homemaker.
She also serves on the Council on Pensions and on the Finance, Ways, and Means and Insurance committees.

Her listed affiliations include the Covington Chamber of Commerce, the South Tipton Chamber of Commerce, the advisory board of Confidential Care Mobile and a life membership in the Disabled American Veterans Auxiliary, and she assists with an eighth-grade girls' group at Bellevue Baptist Church.
